description: Dependency updates, grouped so one PR lands on one gate run.
Monthly window with a three day release age, following the shape mail-calendar proved.
Security fixes are exempt: vulnerabilityAlerts defaults to no schedule and no release-age wait.
The engine pin is not managed here: docs/upstream-sync.md assigns it to the 22:00 integration task.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: A toolchain pin bump can change formatting and clippy output, so it lands on its own PR instead of grouped with package bumps.
The engine is one git source at one rev, and moving it is an integration pass owned by the 22:00 sync task, never a dependency bump.
One workspace, one lockfile: every Rust package moves together. Two branches editing Cargo.lock conflict on the first merge, and on a monthly schedule the loser stays conflicted for a month.
The React SPA and the agent sidecar are separate npm roots with separate lockfiles, so they group independently of Rust.
